name: backoff-resets-after-quiet
description: (v1.8) A run of restarts ends when the ten-minute crash window empties: a crash with no other crash in the ten minutes before it restarts after 1 s again. Crashes at t=0, 30 and 90 s restart after 1, 2 and 4 s; the crash at t=720 s comes after a quiet ten minutes and restarts after 1 s, not 8 s.

steps.event: crash at t=0, 30, 90 s; restarts after 1, 2, 4 s, each ready at once
no crash for ten minutes: the window is empty

steps.why: a new run: step 1, crash 1 of the new window
